SmartDrape

SmartDrape combines the soft look of drapery with adjustable fabric vanes. It is designed for large windows and patio doors where you want light control and easy passage.

Book a Consultation

A softer treatment for wide openings.

The individual fabric vanes let you walk through the treatment without drawing it fully open. At your in-home consultation, we can discuss your doorway, the light you want to keep, and your privacy needs.

What to consider

  • How often you use the patio door
  • The light and privacy you want
  • Fabric colors alongside your room’s finishes
